title: Fix short summary output and ensure quiz shows up to 10 questions

requirements.text: Increase the generated summary length so that uploaded notes produce a noticeably longer, more informative summary (especially in offline processing) and ensure the dashboard renders the full returned summary text without truncation.

quotes: still the generated summary length is very short

acceptanceCriteria: When uploading a non-trivial PDF/TXT/MD file with substantial text, the displayed summary contains substantially more content than the current output (i.e., not just a very short excerpt).
Summary rendering preserves line breaks/paragraphs and does not truncate or collapse content in the UI (the full summary string returned by processing is visible).
Offline mode (no webhook URL configured) produces a longer summary than before for the same input file.

requirements.text: Fix quiz generation/data handling so the Interactive Quiz displays 10 questions when enough source text exists, and do not inadvertently limit the rendered quiz list to fewer items.

quotes: instead of 10 questions only 6 are displayed

acceptanceCriteria: In offline mode, when the uploaded document has sufficient content, the returned quiz_array contains 10 items and the UI displays “Quiz (10 questions)”.
The quiz UI renders all items in quizArray (no slicing/hidden limiting), and the question numbering runs from 1 to the full length of quizArray.
If fewer than 10 questions are available due to insufficient source content, the UI still renders all returned questions and the displayed count matches quizArray.length.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend immutablePaths.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor; only add backend changes if strictly necessary (prefer fixing in frontend/offline processing first).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication providers (Internet Identity remains the only auth).
Adding databases or external backend services.
Changing the overall app feature set beyond fixing summary length and quiz question count issues.
